hooks.command: bash -c 'root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$root" ] || root=$(cd .. 2>/dev/null && pwd -P); if [ -x "$root/bin/fm-subagent-pretool-check.sh" ]; then exec "$root/bin/fm-subagent-pretool-check.sh"; else printf "{\"decision\":\"allow\"}\n"; fi'

Stop.command: bash -c 'root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$root" ] || root=$(cd .. 2>/dev/null && pwd -P); if [ -x "$root/bin/fm-turnend-guard-agy.sh" ]; then exec "$root/bin/fm-turnend-guard-agy.sh"; else printf "{\"decision\":\"allow\"}\n"; fi'
